verdict.rationale: vercel-docs-13 directly claims securing internal agents, apps, and deployments with an identity provider, matching the story closely, but this is a single first-party marketing line with no supporting documentation detail (e.g., SSO/SAML setup, SCIM, specific IdP integrations) and no independent or hands-on corroboration; community evidence instead raises unrelated security-incident transparency concerns rather than confirming or denying IdP-based access control. missing for 10: detailed docs on supported IdPs/protocols (SAML/OIDC/SCIM), setup guides, and independent verification that this SSO-based security actually works as described.
